title: Extension item
description: An extension row: icon, name, kind indicator, description, publisher and actions (Manage, or Install when installable).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon URL (default: generic extension icon); /s/vscode/assets/extension-language-icon.svg is bundled

attributes.name: installable
attributes.description: Not installed: shows the Install button
